title: Hydropower signal entity extraction method, system and terminal based on federal learning
assignee: Guoneng Daduhe Big Data Service Co ltd

pse.problem: Inadequate training data for a single system and non-IID distribution of data between different hydropower stations in the hydropower industry, leading to poor named entity recognition results.
pse.solution_function: The method performs federated learning, enabling personalized model parameters to improve accuracy and overcome insufficient training data for a single system. It also addresses non-IID distribution of data between different systems by controlling some layers.
pse.solution_structure: The method utilizes the BERT pre-training model for sentence embedding and bidirectional GRU layer for processing embedded sentences.
pse.solution_implementation: The system first embeds the hydroelectric signal content using the BERT pre-training model, then passes the embedded sentence to a bidirectional GRU layer. The federated learning algorithm coordinates training across multiple systems and some layers are adapted to achieve personalized model parameters.
pse.effect: Improved named entity recognition accuracy, reduced manual workload, and increased efficiency in judging equipment operation status in the hydropower industry
